info.title: Solar Generation API
info.description: Implemented endpoints: application liveness, OpenAPI, user/admin and device JWT exchange, and jurisdiction-scoped province lists. Active installations can submit append-only readings. Users can retrieve individual readings within their stored jurisdiction. Users can page and filter installation reading history within current jurisdiction.

get.description: Public endpoint. Does not check MongoDB or other dependencies. Supports If-None-Match using a stable strong ETag.

200.description: OpenAPI document with the configured base path

post.summary: Exchange user/admin credentials for a short-lived JWT
post.description: Accept only email and password. Normalize email by trimming/lowercasing; preserve the password exactly. Claims come from the current MongoDB User: sub (public UUID), actor=user, role, readScope, optional provinceId or districtId; admins also receive installation-create, installation-deactivate, installation-delete in permissions. HS256 signatures include configured iss, aud, iat, and exp. No refresh token. Responses are not cacheable. Validly shaped attempts use shared MongoDB limits of 5 per 15 minutes by IP and normalized account email. No passwords, hashes, or internal IDs are returned.

password.description: Must contain a non-whitespace character; surrounding spaces are significant.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid request fields.

value.message: Provide only a valid email and a nonempty password.
Request body must be valid JSON.

example.message: Invalid email or password.

get.summary: List provinces visible to the current user
get.description: National users and admins see all provinces; provincial users see their assigned province; district users see the province containing their assigned district. Apply geographic filters within the stored jurisdiction before counts and paging. Out-of-scope or unknown filter targets produce an empty list. Conflicting ancestry among visible filter targets is 400. Sort by name then public UUID. Repeated/unknown query fields are 400. Verify JWT and current User before rate limits, queries, or conditional requests; ignore stale role/jurisdiction/permissions claims. Shared reads are limited to 120 per minute per current User.

post.summary: Exchange meter credentials for a short-lived installation JWT
post.description: Accept only nonempty meterId and deviceSecret strings, preserving both exactly. Verify the submitted secret against the stored salted scrypt hash; never derive a secret from the development prefix. Unknown meters and secret mismatches share a generic 401. Correct credentials for inactive installations return 403. Active installations receive sub (installation public UUID), actor=installation and scope=installation-write with the same configured HS256, iss, aud and lifetime as user tokens. No user authorization or internal IDs are included. All responses use no-store. Validly shaped attempts use shared MongoDB counters: 5 per 15 minutes per IP and exact meter ID, separate from user-login counters. Reading submission is not implemented.

post.summary: Submit an append-only reading for the authenticated active installation
post.description: Accept exactly four input fields. UUID, installation binding and receivedAt are server controlled. Authentication/ownership and body validation precede shared limits of 30/minute per installation and per IP. All responses are no-store. Active status is rechecked with a parent write inside the insertion transaction; lifecycle conflicts retry with current status/existence. Duplicate timestamps never overwrite history.

get.summary: Page and filter authorized installation reading history
get.description: Current stored user jurisdiction is checked before readings, count, paging or validators. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts read within assigned ancestry. Inactive installation history remains readable. Count and page are read in one snapshot. Stable sort uses recordedAt and publicId in the same direction, default newest first. Shared read limit is 120/minute per user including conditional requests. ETag covers user context, installation, normalized paging/sort, filters and complete response. No Last-Modified is sent because no reliable revision exists for the collection envelope; If-Modified-Since alone cannot return 304. Denied/error responses contain neither data/counts nor ETag/Last-Modified.

get.summary: Read an individual installation reading within current user jurisdiction
get.description: Requires user/admin JWT authentication and current stored jurisdiction. Resolve installation, substation, district and province before reading lookup or validators. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts read only within assigned ancestry. Inactive installations retain readable history. Find readings by both installationId and readingId. Existing installations outside current jurisdiction return 403 before reading lookup; missing ancestry/resources and reading/installation mismatches return 404. Shared user-read limit is 120/minute per user, including admins and conditional requests. The exact public JSON and strong ETag match POST; private caching and authorization on each request prevent validators bypassing access.

get.summary: Page and filter reading history within stored jurisdiction
get.description: Current user authentication and shared 120/minute read limit precede scoped reading queries and conditional responses. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts see only their stored area. Include inactive installations. Resolve explicit geography and ancestry: missing resources return 404, outside-jurisdiction filters 403, and contradictory authorized filters 400. Selecting a district analyst's parent province never broadens district scope. Count/page and authorized geography share a snapshot. Reuse recordedAt/publicId sort and public reading fields. Links preserve all filters. ETag covers current principal, effective query and complete response; matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization. Omit unreliable Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors expose no data/counts or validators.

get.summary: Retrieve the latest measurement within the current user jurisdiction
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute User read limits, valid installation UUID and complete ancestry authorization before reading lookup or conditional GET. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction; cross-jurisdiction access returns 403 even with empty history. Missing installation/ancestry or no readings returns 404. Include inactive history. Select greatest recordedAt (descending publicId tie-breaker), never greatest receivedAt. Return the existing public reading representation with exact strong ETag, private, no-cache and Last-Modified from the selected immutable receivedAt at whole-second precision. If-None-Match takes precedence; matching conditions return bodyless 304. A delayed older measurement preserves validators; a newer measurement changes ETag. Errors use no-store and omit reading validators.

get.summary: Retrieve installation details, related geography and latest measurement
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute user-read limits and complete installation ancestry authorization before data or validators. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction. Cross-jurisdiction access returns 403, missing installation/ancestry 404. Include inactive installations. Read the complete composite in one snapshot. latestReading selects greatest recordedAt with descending publicId tie-breaker, or null for empty history; no full history. Strong ETag covers the current principal and complete composite, including latest-reading, installation status and geography changes. Private, no-cache; matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization. Omit Last-Modified because no reliable whole-composite revision time exists; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators.

get.summary: Retrieve public installation details within the current user jurisdiction
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute User read limits, valid public UUID v4 and complete ancestry authorization before data or validators. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction. Cross-jurisdiction access returns 403; missing installation/ancestry 404. Return active/inactive installation metadata only: id, substationId, meterId and status. Strong ETag is the quoted SHA-256 digest of JSON.stringify of public fields in that order, independent of principal identity and suitable for future admin If-Match. Readings, geography names and private metadata do not affect it. Private, no-cache; matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization. No reliable metadata modification time exists, so omit Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators. No installation writes implemented.

National analysts/admins list nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction. Explicit outside-scope geography returns 403; missing geography/ancestry 404; contradictory authorized or invalid filters 400. A district analyst may select their parent province without expanding scope. Accept only geography UUID filters and offset/limit; include active and inactive installations, order by publicId ascending. Empty results return 200 with an empty collection. Read geography/count/page in one snapshot. ETag covers current principal, effective query and complete envelope; private, no-cache. Matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization/rate limiting. No reliable whole-collection Last-Modified exists; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators/items/counts. No installation writes implemented.

get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute User read limits and a UUID v4 districtId (invalid format 400). Resolve District and Province before substation queries/counts/validators. Missing district/ancestry returns 404. National analysts/admins access nationally; provincial analysts districts in their stored province; district analysts only their assigned district; otherwise 403. Query only URL district substations. Return the full collection without pagination, ordered by name/publicId ascending. No query parameters are accepted; supplied options return 400. Return public id/districtId/name items in count/items envelope; empty authorized districts return 200 with count=0 and empty items. Parent authorization and full list share one read snapshot; count is the list length and pagination fields are omitted. ETag covers current principal, district and complete response; private, no-cache. Matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after access/rate checks. Omit Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators/data/counts.

get.summary: Summarize current power and observed daily energy for an authorized district
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens 401) and shared 120/minute User read limits. Accept exactly one required public UUID v4 districtId query parameter and no other options; missing/invalid/repeated parameters return 400. Missing district or ancestry returns 404; authorize national/admin, assigned province or assigned district before aggregate queries or validators. Capture asOf once per request, including transaction retries. Current power sums each active installation latest recordedAt at or before asOf, if within the inclusive 30-minute freshness window; active installations without eligible readings count as stale. Use Asia/Colombo midnight through asOf inclusive for energy. todayEnergyKwh is observed daily energy that may be incomplete: sum nonnegative consecutive counter differences per installation, including inactive history, skipping decreases and resuming from each lower counter. Use an exact midnight baseline if available; otherwise start at the first in-day sample and flag incomplete. No interpolation, extrapolation, pre-midnight baseline or estimation. Fewer than two daily readings, missing midnight baseline or any decrease counts that installation as incomplete once. Empty districts return zero totals/counts. Read ancestry, status and history in one snapshot. ETag covers current principal and complete response including asOf; private, no-cache. The asOf field uses DD Mon YYYY, hh:mm AM/PM (Sri Lanka), while calculations retain full precision. ETag changes when the displayed timestamp or calculated values change, including freshness expiry and midnight without new readings. Matching If-None-Match yields bodyless 304 only after access/rate checks. Omit Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors are no-store without validators.
